description: Official HS-4 aggregate covering 5 HStat product lines
product: Motherboard, Parts of accounting machines (like ribbons), Parts of calculators

predecessors.note: Typewriter and word-processor parts were dropped as a separate line; the trade now sits across the rest of heading 8473.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.

definitionShare.basis: The heading figure is Comtrade's own aggregate at this level, covering every six-digit line in the heading. The defined figure is the sum of the HStat product lines inside it. The gap is the part of the heading the sector definition does not track.
definitionShare.caution: Summed values omit any member whose own period failed coverage validation, so the share is a lower bound where members are missing.

provisional: 1 of last year's ten largest importers has not filed yet: Other Asia, nes.
Only 78% of last year's reporting economies have filed for this year.
World imports are 1.52 times world exports for this year. The two sides normally agree within a fifth, so one of them is still filling in - usually the export side, which large exporters file later.
